build_stl10_dataset_builder: build the STL-10 dataset builder class that downloads and generates train, test, and unlabeled splits
create_stl10_split_generators: create split generators for train, test, and unlabeled splits with binary image and label files
generate_stl10_examples: generate STL-10 image examples from binary .bin files with 96x96 RGB images and 10-class labels
configure_stl10_dataset_info: configure dataset info with image features, class labels, and supervised keys for the STL-10 dataset
download_stl10_dataset: download and extract the STL-10 dataset archive from Stanford and parse binary image and label files
